scenario.title: Product Search: 200,000 Common-Term LIKE
scenario.trigger: 200,000 products where the same buyer search term appears broadly in title/content/excerpt/meta, stressing LIKE search and result counts.

slow_queries.sql: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS wp_posts.ID FROM wp_posts WHERE 1=1 AND ( wp_posts.ID NOT IN ( SELECT object_id FROM wp_term_relationships WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (6) ) ) AND (((wp_posts.post_title LIKE '%CommonSearchNeedle%') OR (wp_posts.post_excerpt LIKE '%CommonSearchNeedle%') OR (wp_posts.post_content LIKE '%CommonSearchNeedle%'))) AND (wp_posts.post_password = '') AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'product' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'))) GROUP BY wp_posts.ID ORDER BY wp_posts.post_title LIKE '%CommonSearchNeedle%' DESC, wp_posts.post_date DESC LIMIT 0, 16
